title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Company Description :** 

 Backed by over 20 years of experience, Quantum HQ is a modern and innovative firm of qualified finance professionals delivering reliable accounting support to accounting practices and growing businesses.
 





 We are ACCA\-approved and built to work as a dependable extension of your team. Headquartered in London with an office in Texas and delivery teams across India, we support clients across the UK, US, and Australia with scalable back\-office finance capacity.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  




* **Recruitment \& Onboarding:**




 \- Manage and create new Job requirements and source qualified candidates through the platforms
 





      like LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, etc.,
 





 \- Initiate the screening calls, coordinate interviews with location heads, negotiate offers, and
 





     oversee new hires orientation programs.
 





 \- Own and Execute the Onboarding and Off\-boarding workflows and related paperwork.
 




  




* **Employee Relations:**




 \- Mediate workplace disputes and handle grievances.
 





 \- Enforce disciplinary procedures to maintain a safe and productive environment.
 





 \- Act as Presiding Officer for the POSH Committee, organise meetings for the IC.
 




  




* **Compensation \& Benefits:**




 \- Review and validate attendance records prior to payroll.
 





 \- Communicate and coordinate with external vendors for medical insurance.
 





 \- Manage and coordinate special Bonus Payouts and other ad hoc requests.
 




  




* **Performance Management:** 

 Develop evaluation frameworks and coordinate periodic appraisals to support employee career growth.



  




* **Compliance \& Policy:** 

 Ensure company policies align with local and national labour laws to minimize legal risks



  




* **Social Media Management:** 

 Draft and execute posts for Company level Announcements, fun events, and other updates. Enhance the social media visibility and the web presence of the company on platforms such as LinkedIn and Instagram.



  




* **Vendor Coordination:** 

 Constantly manage and monitor the various external vendors ranging from procurement, house\-keeping, facility management, etc.



  




* **Employee Engagement:** 

 Design, plan, and execute engaging company themes, events, and activities that foster a positive work culture and boost team morale.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Minimum 3\-6 years of relevant HR experience
* Proven experience in recruitment, employee engagement, performance management, Compensation and Benefits.
* Excellent communication skills (including fluency in Hindi) with the ability to foster long\-term relationships across leadership, external partners and Employees.
* Adherence to the highest professional ethics and standards, maintaining integrity and transparency.
* Good team\-management abilities.

title: Talent Procurement Purchasing Assistant GDS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title: Talent Procurement Purchasing Assistant GDS**
**The opportunity**
 The purpose of the global EY organization is to Build a better working world. The insights and services the organization provides help to drive long\-term value for clients, people and society and to build trust in the capital markets. An essential function under EY Business Enablement, Supply Chain Services (SCS) is a global team with more than 600 professionals in over 35 countries supporting the EY organization across the globe. This structure helps enable knowledge\-sharing across categories and regions, streamlining efforts in seeking innovative suppliers that can provide exceptional client service to maximize SCS’s value for the EY organization and the world's supply chain.
   

  

 A key component of SCS is Global Procurement, whose purpose is to drive more significant synergies and value creation from sourcing to contract lifecycle management, deliver exceptional client experiences and build more vital collaboration to manage Technology, Talent and Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) spend categories. We forge meaningful supplier relationships and strengthen supplier resilience to help EY maximize long\-term value for its people, clients and communities.
   

  

 As a Talent Procurement Team member you will have the opportunity to work with a professional team of Procurement professionals in a global environment and work with colleagues on interesting sourcing projects in the GDS. Developing our people is key to deliver quality to our internal and external clients and is perfectly in line with our purpose of building a better working world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to EY stakeholders by delivering pipeline projects, exceptional customer service, and measurable value through cost savings, cost avoidance, and contract value realization.
* Partner with senior stakeholders and Global Procurement colleagues to develop category strategies aligned with the overall global strategy.
* Build relationships with key EY stakeholders and provide regular updates on category insights and progress.
* Promote and facilitate the Global Procurement and Supply Chain Policy and related processes, ensuring project teams and stakeholders understand their value and comply with requirements.
* Manage and support requests for proposals (RFPs), including commercial and contractual negotiations, in close collaboration with Legal (GCO), Global Client Serving Partners, Sector Leaders, and other business partners.
* Improve sourcing efficiency and compliance by implementing purchase orders and using AI tools where appropriate.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies that align with business priorities and deliver commercial value and operational efficiency.
* Lead complex sourcing projects from opportunity assessment through contract execution, including competitive events, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and ongoing governance.
* Advise business leaders on procurement and influence decisions through market intelligence, spend analysis, and strategic recommendations.
* Oversee the negotiation and management of MSAs, FSAs, SOWs, amendments, and other commercial contracts.
* Collaborate with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Information Security, and Compliance teams to implement appropriate contractual protections and manage supplier risks effectively.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic suppliers, conduct governance reviews, monitor performance, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support supplier onboarding, due diligence, compliance reviews, and remediation activities as needed.
* Engage extensively with stakeholders and partner effectively with senior business leaders across functions and geographies.
* Act as a trusted procurement advisor, providing commercial guidance and serving as an escalation point for strategic supplier and contractual matters.
* Contribute to procurement transformation, process improvement, capability development, and the mentoring of procurement professionals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Business acumen and commercial skills to help leadership drive procurement and demand management strategies across a broad array of portfolios.
* Strong sourcing project delivery with the ability to deliver compliance processes
* Strong negotiator and influencer capable of supporting leadership in driving alignment with key senior stakeholders and leaders.
* Deep knowledge of Talent categories and understanding for Talent categories.
* The ability to drive change by building strong, trusting relationships with senior stakeholders and business partners
* Sound judgment and decision\-making abilities
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage and prioritize workload
* Demonstrate a positive attitude and have an appetite for change and learning


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Experience in Talent Procurement in a collaborative, high\-performance environment and preferable experience with the Human Capital Procurement category
* Strong procurement expertise and commercial acumen to drive sourcing and demand management strategies across a broad array of category services.
* Ability to align efforts with key stakeholders and influence these leaders, as necessary, and possess a global mindset
* Experience on execution of online Rfx and e\-Auctions
* Advanced English and able to lead conversations autonomously.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A Bachelor’s and follow\-on degree in Business or similar discipline is recommended.
* CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management) will be a plus
* 10\+ years of experience in Procurement
* Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English
* Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization
* Experience working collaboratively, virtually and independently


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for a high energy individual who embraces change to ensure we can continue to strategically deliver world\-class quantitative and brand value for the global EY organization in an ever\-changing business environment.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Flexible working arrangements possible: to achieve a lifestyle balance
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
Hire22\.ai is India’s 1st Agentic AI Job Portal for mid and senior\-level professionals, connecting candidates directly with employers through intelligent AI matching.
 



  





 Every JobCoNCT stays active for only 22 hours, apply quickly to avoid missing interview\-ready opportunities.
 



  





**Job Description** 




**Role Overview:** 




 Join our dynamic Talent Acquisition team as a Recruitment Specialist, where you will play a crucial role in sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates for both IT and Non\-IT positions. This position is vital for ensuring we attract and hire top talent across various industries, contributing to the company's growth and success.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Source candidates through platforms such as Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn, referrals, and social media.
* Perform Boolean searches to identify high\-quality candidates.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for IT and Non\-IT positions.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews to assess qualifications and cultural fit.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a seamless process.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process to maintain engagement.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for multiple open positions, ensuring timely closures.
* Post job advertisements and monitor job portal performance for effectiveness.
* Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and ATS records accurately.
* Collaborate with hiring managers to understand role requirements and provide regular updates.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience from sourcing to onboarding.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2–6 years of experience in IT and Non\-IT recruitment.
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end recruitment and candidate lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn, and other sourcing platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Boolean Search techniques.
* Proficiency in using recruitment tools and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and recruitment reporting.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong negotiation and candidate relationship management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and detail\-focused.



  





**Preferred Qualifications/Good to Have:** 



* Experience hiring across multiple domains and industries.
* Knowledge of sourcing strategies for niche and lateral hiring.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced recruitment environment.
* Familiarity with recruitment analytics and hiring metrics.



  





**What Makes This Opportunity Attractive:** 



* Opportunity to recruit for diverse IT and Non\-IT roles across multiple industries.
* Collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Performance\-driven career progression.
* Competitive salary with incentives based on hiring performance.

title: HR Development (L&D)
description:
**About the Job** 




 As a specialist in electronics and software for the past 20 years, in\-tech is a dynamic, fast\-growing engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany employing around 2350 employees globally across 20 project locations in 8 countries.
 



 in\-tech develops innovative engineering solutions for the automotive, rail, aerospace, defence, and industrial sectors.
 



 We are committed to a flexible, modern work culture and work\-life balance. Our colour orange stands for liveliness, warmth, and dynamism. We value a strong team spirit, fresh ideas and a positive work culture. We call it the “Orange Spirit”!
 



 Since 2024, in\-tech became a subsidiary of Infosys Ltd.This role is responsible for coordinating, delivering, and maintaining training and development programs for freshers and junior team members in the automotive engineering services domain, working closely with German in\-house training teams, project managers, technical leads, and HR. The ideal candidate has 3\+ years of experience in L\&D or HR development, strong communication and organizational skills, and a hands\-on, collaborative mindset within a technical or automotive environment. If you’re passionate about joining a growing and dynamic team with a company with a positive culture and team spirit, we’d love to connect with you!
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Support the design and implementation of training programs in close collaboration with our German in\-house training team and Infosys training programs, with a focus on administrative coordination and operational execution.
* Tailor and maintain training content to engage and upskill freshers and junior resources in the automotive engineering services domain.
* Collaborate with in\-house project managers, technical leads, and the HR Business Partner to identify skill gaps and training needs.
* Coordinate and administer onboarding sessions to familiarize freshers with company organizational processes, tools, technologies, and company values.
* Maintain and update technical and soft skills training modules to enhance the capabilities of team members.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to freshers, ensuring a smooth transition into project roles.
* Track and document the progress of trainees, provide constructive feedback, and maintain reporting on training KPIs.
* Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), including scheduling, enrolment, content uploads, and reporting.
* Stay updated on industry trends and advancements to incorporate relevant knowledge into training programs.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment of training objectives with project requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and report on their impact on employee skills development.
* Support engineering team members with additional training coordination during transitions between projects.
* Handle day\-to\-day administrative tasks related to HR development activities, including training logistics, documentation, and communication with stakeholders.
* Support planning, coordinating and steering all global developmental processes, including talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and performance management.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor's or master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience of at least 3\+ years in a learning \& development, training administration, or HR development role \- ideally within the automotive sector or a similar digital/technical services environment.
* Solid understanding of training coordination processes and HR development practices.
* Familiarity with automotive engineering principles, tools, and technologies is an advantage.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to coordinate and deliver engaging training content for freshers and junior resources with a positive and supportive approach.
* Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and related administrative tools.
* Knowledge of SuccessFactors and SAP would be beneficial but not essential.
* Strong organizational skills with a hands\-on, operative mindset.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team structure, supporting HR Business Partners and German\-based L\&D leadership on project\-level topics.
* Should be willing to assist in managing all kind of processes \& projects in the HR development field.



  





**Apply with us** 




 If you have experience and team spirit and are looking for a great place to work, then start your job with us.
 



 As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, in\-tech is committed to equal employment opportunity without regard for age, race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

 The Senior Manager – Recruitment will lead and manage the end\-to\-end talent acquisition function, ensuring achievement of hiring targets within defined timelines, budget guidelines, and quality standards. The role involves driving sourcing strategies, managing recruitment teams, overseeing stakeholder and vendor management, optimizing recruitment processes, and ensuring a strong candidate experience while aligning hiring delivery with business objectives.
 



  





**Duties and responsibilities:** 




  





**Recruitment Strategy \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, workforce plans, and hiring priorities.
* Develop recruitment strategies for volume, niche, and leadership hiring requirements.
* Create sourcing plans aligned to business expansion, attrition trends, and critical skill requirements.
* Drive recruitment process improvements to enhance efficiency, candidate quality, and hiring outcomes.



**Team Management** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of recruiters and sourcing specialists.
* Allocate requisitions based on recruiter capability, bandwidth, and business priority.
* Monitor team productivity, sourcing effectiveness, and recruitment pipeline health.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and capability\-building initiatives for the recruitment team.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment SLAs, policies, and compliance standards



**Talent Sourcing \& Networking** 



* Oversee sourcing activities across multiple channels including job portals, employee referrals, social media platforms, consultants, and internal databases.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
* Develop market intelligence on talent availability, compensation trends, and competitor hiring practices.
* Strengthen employer branding initiatives to improve talent attraction.



**Screening \& Selection** 



* Guide recruiters in candidate assessment and shortlisting processes to ensure hiring quality.
* Ensure structured screening and interview processes are followed across all business units.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to ensure timely interview feedback and decision\-making.
* Monitor selection quality and ensure alignment with competency and cultural fit requirements.



**Stakeholder \& Candidate Management** 



* Build strong working relationships with business leaders and hiring stakeholders.
* Ensure seamless and professional candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Handle escalations related to recruitment delivery, offer negotiations, and candidate engagement.



**Recruitment Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure accurate maintenance of recruitment data, reports, and ATS records.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, dashboards, and periodic hiring reports.
* Ensure compliance with company recruitment policies, audit requirements, and documentation standards.
* Support HR audits and management reviews related to talent acquisition processes.



**Recruitment Budget Planning** 



* Prepare and manage the annual recruitment budget in alignment with workforce planning and business hiring projections.
* Monitor recruitment\-related expenses including job portals, consultancy fees, campus hiring, employee referral payouts, travel expenses etc.
* Track budget utilization against approved allocations and ensure cost\-effective hiring practices.
* Coordinate with Finance and Business Heads for recruitment forecasting and manpower budgeting exercises.



**External Vendor Management** 



* Manage external recruitment vendors, job portals, and hiring partners to support recruitment activities
* Coordinate and monitor recruitment processes related to consultants, agencies, and sourcing platforms to ensure effective hiring support.
* Oversee the usage and performance of job portals and external hiring channels to improve sourcing efficiency and recruitment outcomes.
* Ensure recruitment activities comply with labour laws and internal HR policies.
* Support employer branding initiatives by promoting company culture and values through job postings and social media platforms.



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 




  




* MBA in HR stream or Graduation in any discipline
* 10\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing a recruitment team.
* Experience handling volume hiring, niche hiring, and stakeholder management.
* Exposure to ATS platforms, job portals, market standards and recruitment analytics preferred.

* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Schedule Management
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Tracking
   

  

 Business Acumen
   

  

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
   

  

 Data Accuracy \& Reporting
   

  

 Adaptability

* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.

title: HR Executive
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **HR Executive** 
 to manage end\-to\-end HR operations and administration for the organization. The role will be responsible for talent acquisition, manpower planning, employee engagement, performance management, statutory compliance, employee relations and HR administration.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Planning**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for plant and corporate positions.
* Develop manpower plans based on business and operational requirements.
* Manage onboarding, induction, employee documentation and exits.
* Partner with business heads to identify current and future manpower requirements.


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Manage PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and other statutory compliances.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR MIS and personnel documentation.
* Coordinate statutory audits, inspections and compliance activities.


**Employee Relations \& Engagement**
* Handle employee queries, grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Maintain positive employee relations and workplace culture.
* Drive employee engagement, welfare and retention initiatives.
* Support industrial relations and shop\-floor employee matters.


**Performance Management \& Training**
* Coordinate performance appraisal and review processes.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Coordinate employee training, learning and development initiatives.
* Monitor training effectiveness and employee development.


**Payroll \& HR Administration**
* Coordinate payroll inputs, attendance, leave and employee master data.
* Work closely with Finance/payroll vendors to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Manage HR policies, procedures and employee communication.
* Oversee general administration, facilities and vendor coordination as required.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree with MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* 2\+ years of experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations roles.
* Experience in manufacturing / engineering / industrial environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management and HR operations.
* Good knowledge of PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and POSH.
* Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Office and HRMS.


 Skills: compliance,employee relations,hr operations
